_comment: To add a new devotional: copy one of the entries below, paste it at the TOP of the array, and update the fields. The 'youtubeId' is the part of a YouTube URL after 'v=' and before any '&'. Example: for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6G7a44B6rwg, the id is '6G7a44B6rwg'. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD.
